frequency_question: How often does the Ministry of Finance follow through on contested digital payment merchant fee introductions by the announced deadline without rolling them back or delaying them?
membership_rule: Includes announced policy changes regarding MDR or transaction charges on digital public infrastructure where merchant bodies pushed back; excludes purely technical upgrades or subsidies not altering merchant pricing.

cases.name: Zero-MDR policy enforcement on UPI and RuPay (2020)
Proposed reintroduction of UPI MDR discussions and subsequent deferral (2021)
Discussion paper on payment charges by RBI (2022)

coverage_note: 3 named; captures the primary modern era of UPI commercialization debates
known_gaps: Excludes minor administrative clarifications that did not alter the core zero-MDR status quo.
skeleton: Key policy announcements regarding digital transaction fees subject to heavy political sensitivity and merchant lobbying
multiplier: 1 hit out of 3 major contested policy windows
validity_reason: Policy frameworks governing digital payments remain anchored to current political sensitivities for at least two years
